description: This file defines the DeadlockDetector class, which inspects process and thread snapshots to identify deadlocks involving threads, locks, and possibly binder transactions within a Java-based Android application environment.

classes.name: DeadlockDetector
classes.description: A utility class to detect deadlocks affecting the main thread of a process in Android JVM snapshot data.

classes.name: DeadlockDetector.ThreadRecord
classes.description: Represents a thread involved in a deadlock cycle, including its process and thread snapshots.

classes.name: DeadlockDetector.LockRecord
classes.description: Represents a lock held by a process and thread, used to track lock ownership during deadlock detection.

methods.name: detectDeadlocks
methods.description: Main method to analyze VM traces and identify deadlocked processes involving the main thread based on lock and binder transaction cycles.

methods.name: addLockRecordsForThread
methods.description: Helper method to collect lock records from a thread that are not yet visited during deadlock detection.
